description: Olulugbara lulimi lwa Central Sudanic olwogerwa abantu ng’obukadde bubiri mu West Nile, okwetooloola Arua, Koboko, Maracha ne Terego, ne mu Congo.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lugbara courses (#132) with low confidence in Lugbara; needs a native-speaker review. The Luganda needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/lgg).

why.title: Olulimi lwa **Arua, Koboko n’olusozi Wati.**
why.text: Olulugbara lwa luganda n’Olumadi, Oluaringa n’Olulogo, ennimi za Central Sudanic eziva mu Uganda okutuuka e Congo ne South Sudan. Luyige olw’ab’omu maka, entambula, emirimu, n’ennyimba, amazina n’engero za West Nile.

cards.title: Eri ab’omu maka
cards.text: Yogera ne bajjajja n’ab’eŋŋanda e Arua ne Koboko.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Arua okutuuka e Koboko, Nebbi ne ku lusozi Wati.

cards.title: Eri abaagala okumanya
cards.text: Zuula olulimi olw’amaloboozi ag’enjawulo, nga terulina bika bya mannya era ebigambo tebikyuka.

landing.audience: Aboogera Oluganda abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, ab’omu maka abava mu West Nile, n’abatambuze abagenda e Arua.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’ennamba, oluvannyuma ab’omu maka, emmere, akatale, essaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.emma: Omugenyi ayiga Olulugbara nga tannaba kutambula
